card.name: The word blood before glucose or pressure
card.fires_on: The word "blood" (or "Blood") when it begins a phrase such as blood glucose, blood pressure, blood sugar, blood urea or blood vessels. It appears in drug-label and health text.

modes.label: Blood glucose and sugar
modes.description: "blood" introduces glucose or sugar measures, often in diabetes drug text.
modes.example: test fasting plasma glucose (FPG), HbA1c, and optimize<< blood>> glucose.

modes.label: Blood pressure and other blood terms
modes.description: "blood" starts blood pressure, urea, or vessel terms.
modes.example: Continue<< blood>> pressure monitoring until desired effect is achieved.
